snippet.title: Bank of Africa Kenya
snippet.description: BANK OF AFRICA – KENYA LIMITED (BOA-KENYA) is a commercial bank providing banking services to corporate, SME and retail clientele. The bank commenced operations in Kenya in July 2004, after acquiring the Kenyan branch of Credit Agricole Indosuez, a large international French bank which had operated in the country for over 20 years.

snippet.title: The Story of Money Podcast | Financial Times
snippet.description:
They say money makes the world go round. But was it always this way? And how did we get to this point anyway?

Find out on The Story of Money from the Financial Times, with Gillian Tett and Robin Wigglesworth. Each week, they revisit the moments when money shaped history.

From ancient rulers wiping out debts to 19th-century frontier America where banking blurred into banditry, financial history has a habit of coming back around. So whether it’s today’s AI investment boom or the next market crash, chances are we’ve seen something like it before. And those who don’t know their financial past won’t just repeat it — they could lose money too.

Subscribe for free to The Story of Money from the FT— a history show for finance geeks, and a finance show for history buffs. And if you’re neither, Gillian and Robin might just make you both.

snippet.title: 3T Academy
snippet.description:
Welcome! This channel is dedicated to XRP, Ripple, the XRP Ledger (XRPL), and the future of digital finance. You'll find daily updates on XRP market news, price analysis, tokenization, institutional adoption, and educational content covering projects like XLM, HBAR, XDC, and the broader crypto ecosystem.

Beyond market insights, I also focus on crypto wealth protection-helping you understand self-custody, digital asset security, trusts, LLCS, tax considerations, estate planning, and strategies for protecting your holdings for the long term.

My goal is to simplify complex topics and provide educational content that helps you make informed decisions as the digital asset industry continues to evolve.

If you're interested in XRP, blockchain innovation, and building a strong foundation for your crypto future, subscribe and join the community.

snippet.title: The Machine Room
snippet.description:
We reveal the hidden systems that run the world.

The Machine Room takes something you touch every day, like a grocery receipt, a phone or a cargo ship, and peels it back layer by layer to the machine underneath: the chokepoints, supply chains, money flows and business models most people never see.

Series
If It Closed Tomorrow: the chokepoints the world can't afford to lose, starting with the Panama Canal.
Follow the Money: how companies really make their money.
What One Minute Costs: what a single minute of failure costs.

Every episode is researched and fact checked by people, with sources on screen and in the description. Maps and motion graphics are drawn in house.

Narration is a synthetic voice. Research and writing by people.

New episodes every other week. Subscribe so you catch the next one.
